messages.text: I want to cancel my order and get a refund, it hasn't shipped yet. How long does that take?

I can look up the order to confirm its status, but cancelling it and issuing the refund isn't something I can do from here — that happens through our support flow. I don't have a timeline for how long a refund takes once it's cancelled.

Can you give me the email on the order and the order number so I can check its status first?
